_note: Models borrowed from the projects themselves. They are read, never written: scripts/build-pieces.mjs copies each into build/pieces/_src/ (git-ignored) and Blender reads the copy. Where each one is on this machine goes in its env variable or in sources.local.json next to this file (git-ignored), as { "lander.blend": "C:/path/to/lander.blend" }, so no local folder name is committed.

lander.blend.use: Mission Builder 3D: the game's own lander (blender/_work/blend/lander.blend in that repo, built by its blender/10_lander.py)

kps-tools.glb.use: KPS Clean-O: the storefront's own nine product models (style-previews/3d/_bake/tools.glb in that repo)
